name: Chihuahua

standard.note: Chihuahua's plate from the 2022 statewide swap is a plain white plate with 'CHIHUAHUA' across the top and the Mexican and Chihuahua coats of arms near the bottom, built with a reflective security film and a barcode.

plates.title: Current design (2022)
plates.fact: Chihuahua's plate from the 2022 statewide swap is a plain white plate with 'CHIHUAHUA' across the top and the Mexican and Chihuahua coats of arms near the bottom, built with a reflective security film and a barcode.

plates.title: Drivers with disabilities
plates.fact: Chihuahua's revenue office (Recaudación de Rentas) issues special plates for people with disabilities.

notes: The 2022 swap was mandatory: plates and registration cards from before it lost validity on April 30, 2022, and 1.5 million new sets went out from May 2022 (https://www.chihuahua.gob.mx/prensa/para-garantizar-la-seguridad-en-el-estado-da-conocer-secretaria-de-hacienda-requisitos-para). The standard image is the government's 'Diseño de placas 2022' slide (955x706, ratio 1.35) showing the front (F) and rear (T) plates, not a tight crop of one plate. I found no World Cup, eco or classic designs. I saw the disability plates only as a requirements graphic, with no plate picture. [Claude] standard picture not used: it shows the front and rear plates side by side.
